note: No quarterly calls: company holds one annual call after Q4 results (practice 'started last year' per May 2023 call), so standard 8-quarter mode is impossible. Fallback events = the five annual calls (FY22-FY26). Transcripts opened: May 2023, May 2024, May 2025, May 2026. FY22 call (May/Jun 2022) transcript not retrieved; its 2-4 year expansion estimate rests on the company's own restatement in the May 2023 call p.5 (citing AR 2021-22) plus alphastreet summary [unverified]. Outcome documents opened: Q3 FY26 investor release (4 Feb 2026), Q1 FY27 investor release (1 Aug 2026); Q2 FY26 release seen as search extract only. Q1 FY27 release held only restatements (UAE 'minor delays while remaining within the overall project timeline'; Barjora ramp) - not a separate event. AR FY24-FY26 not opened (FY26 Directors' report/MD&A seen via indiainfoline extract only: UAE line 'expected to commission during the current year'; fourth (UAE) and fifth (India) lines 'on the roadmap', undated - not captured). AGM proceedings not retrieved. Capture rule applied: each distinct dated commitment graded at the event where that date was first given; later restatements of the same date, or narrowings inside the same deadline (May 2024 'third quarter of the current fiscal' for Barjora, 'Q3 FY26' for UAE, solar 'well before December'), folded into the original; a new date set after an earlier deadline lapsed is a new promise. May 2024 call therefore carries no new gradeable promise and is excluded from the score. Score: 3 graded events, weights 3-2-1: (1.0x3 + 1.5x2 + 1.5x1) / 6 x 5 = 6.25 -> 6.3. Pattern: every capacity timeline slipped (Barjora line: FY25 -> Q3 FY25 -> ~Sep 2025 -> Nov-Dec 2025 -> commercial 27 Mar 2026; UAE line: FY26 -> Q3 FY26 -> dry runs Q4 CY2025 -> trial Aug-Sep 2026 -> commercial by Q3 FY27, still not commercial at review date); capital, debt and ancillary commitments delivered. Management routinely declines revenue/margin guidance (class 9 refusals recorded, not scored - no prior guidance withdrawn). Classes none stated across window: 6 (ETR and normalisations), except a May 2023 remark on residual tax shield (~Rs 23 Cr) with no rate or date - not captured. v1.2 rule-7 re-grade (supersedes the capture rule, FY22-source and score lines above): 2-4 yr two-line expansion traced to Nov 2021 investor deck (added, outside_window; clock to ~Nov 2025 per Jun 2022 call p.8 '2 to 4 from when we made the announcement'); Barjora line graded 0 (commercial 27 Mar 2026), UAE line 1 (reasoned re-set in May 2025 call); all later Barjora/UAE dates (May 2023-May 2026) folded in; Jun 2022 transcript opened (adds open Biax 3x-turnover target); UAE ~Rs 250 Cr capex moved May 2024 -> May 2023, so May 2024 event dropped (nothing left captured; checked); May 2026 utilisation item folded into May 2025. Rule 6: no class-10 items, nothing removed. Score, weights 5-1 by position: (1.5x4 + 2.0x3 + 0.5x1) / (2x8) x 10 = 7.8; 6.3 -> 7.8.
